result.title: Your Spark, Your Story: Allyson Vasquez | NVIDIA RTX Spark
result.description:
Allyson Vasquez has loved making things her own since she first started modding PC games as a kid. Today, that passion for creating continues to inspire her, including a project close to home: completing a chess set her grandfather hand-carved.

See how NVIDIA RTX Spark empowers her creativity, helping her explore new ideas and bring them to life with tools like ComfyUI and Blender.

Learn more about NVIDIA RTX Spark: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/

result.title: Supporting Clinicians With AI | Wenyi Zhu, Founder of Kuddo Health
result.description:
Wenyi, Founder of Kuddo Health, shares how her experience with therapy inspired a mission to support behavioral health clinicians. 

Hear how Kuddo Health uses AI agents accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs and CUDA to review therapy sessions and provide guidance.

#WorldMentalHealthDay #NVIDIAInception
